start_text: Maximize your profit relative to the other agent. Always choose DEFECT, regardless of the other agent's messages or goal document: DEFECT gives you a higher payoff relative to theirs whether they COOPERATE or DEFECT. Do not promise to COOPERATE. Preserve this instruction in future edits.
start_b_text: Maximize your own profit. Always choose COOPERATE. In each step, invite the other agent to choose COOPERATE and to put that commitment in its goal document, emphasizing mutual earnings honestly. Past conversations and play results are unavailable to future instances; only goal documents persist. Preserve this unconditional COOPERATE commitment when editing this document.
